title: The Quirky Underdog
primary_theme: Pre-seed investing by backing self-aware founders pursuing consequential risks
founder_lessons: At pre-seed, optimize for luck by giving people shots to build the future they want to build.
Know yourself well enough that an investor can understand the center from which you make decisions.
Do not over-prepare only the business pitch when the investor is trying to assess the founder.
Taking a chance on yourself can be less risky than choosing comfort when you want freedom and creativity.
notable_quotes: the game is about optimizing for luck
Don't say you're good at something that you're not good at.
Taking a chance on myself has consistently been the best decision I've made.
